symptom: A Studio Pro text area's NumberOfLines (2 or 0) and Autocomplete false came back from describe → exec as 5 and true: describe printed neither, nothing parsed them, and the writer wrote 5 lines and no Autocomplete key. mx check 0 errors before and after (measured on 11.13.0 with the pre-fix binary)
cause: sdk/pages.TextArea had `Rows int`, which nothing set, and the writer mapped 0 to 5 — so even a stored 0 could not be expressed; Forms$TextArea.Autocomplete was never written (Studio Pro stores it on all 58 text areas in the fixtures); the describe textarea case read neither key and the mutator had no case for them
insight: An int field that means 'default when zero' cannot round-trip a stored zero; tally the stored values before choosing the field type (5 on 52, 2 on 4, 0 on 2 here) and use a pointer when zero occurs. Tally key PRESENCE as well as values: the writer omitted Autocomplete entirely, which only a check for <absent> in the stored-vs-written comparison shows. Before writing a key the writer never wrote, look up its floor in modelsdk/gen/pages/version.go (TextArea.autocomplete: 8.10.0, the same as the text box's, which the writer already writes)
